label: copy-phase input y, late in long sequences
explanation: Fires almost only on copy-phase steps where the fed-back input is the letter y (99.8% of activation mass on in_tok=y; never on y during the original phase, almost never on other tokens apart from a few q). Strength depends on absolute step: near zero before t=12, rate climbs steeply from t=13 to t=15-17, so most mass comes from L=8-9 sequences near the end of the copy (to_go 0-3). Within that regime only about half of late copy-phase y inputs fire, and that gating is not explained; steps that also output y or q (e.g. a repeated y y) fire with high precision (~0.85) and include the top activations, but they cover only a small share of mass. Does not fire on y in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on non-y inputs.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: y, q, -, <DEL>, r, j; least: x, c, o, f) and the token being output (most: y, q, g, a, k, e; least: j, o, -, i); timing cues that raise it most: L=8 & t=7, recall_idx=7, t=15.
